Name: Dishon, Son of Seir
Summary: Dishon was a son of Seir the Horite, and one of the dukes of the Horites.
KeyStory: Dishon is named among Seir's sons and among the dukes of the Horites in the land of Seir.
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
